svg.title: A desire path: the paved walkway takes a right angle from start to goal, a worn shortcut cuts diagonally across the lawn
svg.desc: Schematic drawing. A light lawn area with a gray paved path that runs from the start at the bottom left along the bottom edge and then up the right side to the goal. A dashed gold line cuts diagonally across the lawn from start to goal: the desire path that people actually walk.
svg.text: The most honest user research in the world
A desire path: frequency and escapability, written in grass · schematic
The paved way – the route the design planned
The desire path – where the shortcut
actually runs, three times a day
Apps have desire paths too – watch where the shortcuts appear. A photo of a real one may replace this schematic.
